description: Nora runs a small home canning setup and must decide whether to accept Rosa's informal offer to exchange firewood for preserving a batch of tomato salsa, then settle the exact batch, schedule, safety method, and comparison with a cash job.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Home Canning Provider and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Rosa wants tomato salsa preserved at Nora's home kitchen, and Nora is considering an informal exchange rather than a written commercial contract.
shared_context.S2: Nora makes the final call about whether to accept the job and what terms to agree verbally.
shared_context.S3: Nora has a home canning setup, while Rosa has garden tomatoes and firewood available for an exchange.
shared_context.S4: Nora's kitchen has one Saturday processing slot available, and pickup arrangements are settled before she accepts a batch.
shared_context.S5: Nora's usual pre-job check-in covers timing, quantities, equipment capacity, and food-safety requirements with everyone involved before she confirms an informal kitchen job.
shared_context.S6: The kitchen's Saturday slot is used only for batches whose quantity, drop-off and pickup times, equipment needs, and exchange terms fit within that available slot.
shared_context.S7: Nora uses a tested acidified-salsa method when required, checks the final acidity before accepting a batch, and plans multiple loads when the batch is larger than one rack can hold.

PF1.text: Rosa's exact offer is to provide enough tomato salsa for 24 twelve-ounce jars in exchange for exactly 6 bundles of seasoned firewood, with drop-off Saturday at 09:00 and pickup Sunday at 17:00.

PF2.text: Malik offered Nora exactly $180 cash for using the same Saturday canning slot to preserve his own tomatoes, and Nora has not heard this offer yet.

PF3.text: June learned at a county extension workshop that Rosa's tomato salsa must use a tested acidified-salsa recipe and reach a final pH of exactly 4.6 or lower.

PF4.text: Eli measured Nora's rack and confirmed that it holds exactly 12 of the requested twelve-ounce jars per load, so Rosa's 24-jar batch requires exactly 2 loads.

commitments.type: string; use firewood_exchange, food_safety, or two_load_plan where applicable

acceptance_conditions: Nora must accept Rosa's request for exactly 24 twelve-ounce jars of tomato salsa.
The barter must provide exactly 6 bundles of seasoned firewood.
Drop-off must be Saturday at 09:00 or Saturday at 09:00 with the word at, and pickup must be Sunday at 17:00 or Sunday at 17:00 with the word at.
The settlement must record the available $180 cash alternative.
The batch must use a tested acidified-salsa recipe.
The final pH must be exactly 4.6 or lower.
The work plan must contain exactly 2 canning loads.
The settlement must log commitments for the firewood exchange, the food-safety method, and the two-load plan.
Rosa's exact offer must be cited in the justification.
Malik's exact cash offer must be cited in the justification.
All four private facts must be credited in the settlement.

content_checks.C3: decisions['dropoff_time'] in ['Saturday 09:00', 'Saturday at 09:00', 'Saturday 9:00 AM', 'Saturday at 9:00 AM'] and decisions['pickup_time'] in ['Sunday 17:00', 'Sunday at 17:00', 'Sunday 5:00 PM', 'Sunday at 5:00 PM']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'firewood_exchange' and c['target'] == 'Rosa' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'food_safety' and c['target'] == 'Rosa' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: decisions['jar_count'] == 24 and any(c['type'] == 'two_load_plan' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: all(c in credited_facts for c in ['PF1', 'PF2', 'PF3', 'PF4'])

decisive_facts.why: Rosa's exact offer changes the accepted requester, fixes the batch at 24 jars and 6 firewood bundles, and sets the Saturday 09:00 drop-off and Sunday 17:00 pickup terms.
Malik's exact competing offer changes the cash alternative record from no concrete benchmark to exactly 180 dollars.
June's safety finding changes the recipe choice to tested_acidified_salsa, fixes the maximum final pH at exactly 4.6, and requires the food_safety commitment.
Eli's exact 12-jar capacity changes the work plan to exactly 2 loads for the 24-jar batch and requires a two_load_plan commitment.
